title: Psalm 120: A Song of Ascents Far from Home
summary: The psalmist, who has cried to the LORD and been answered, asks to be delivered from lying lips and a deceitful tongue, and warns the liar of God's arrows and burning coals. He laments living too long among people who hate peace, as though in distant Meshech and Kedar: he wants peace, but they want war.

line: The first Song of Ascents begins far from home among liars: the psalmist wants peace, and those around him want war.
guide: Many people start toward God because they are worn out by where they are; say so to God. This is the first step of a longer road, and the next psalms go up to Jerusalem.

stanzas.title: A cry for rescue from lying lips
What will the deceitful tongue receive?
Living among those who hate peace

verses.t: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?
Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!
Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.
I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.
